steps.title: BOOK YOUR COLLECTION
steps.body: Book online, by WhatsApp or by phone and choose a convenient collection time.

steps.title: WE COLLECT
steps.body: We collect your clothes directly from your home or business.

steps.title: WE CLEAN & CARE
steps.body: Every item is inspected, cleaned using the appropriate process and professionally finished.

services.title: Dry Cleaning
services.body: Gentle care for suits, dresses, coats and more. Every item is inspected, pre-treated and finished by hand.
services.includes: Pre-spotting, gentle eco-cleaning, hand pressing and protective packaging.
services.suitableFor: Suits, silk, wool, cashmere, coats and delicate garments.

services.title: Wash, Dry & Fold
services.body: Everyday laundry service for everyday clothes. Washed, dried, folded and ready to wear.
services.includes: Professional wash with eco-friendly detergents, tumble dry and neat folding.
services.suitableFor: Everyday clothing, t-shirts, jeans, gym wear, children's clothes.

services.title: Ironing & Pressing
services.body: Perfectly pressed ironing service, ready to wear. Crisp shirts, sharp trousers, every time.
services.includes: Professional hand pressing or steam finishing depending on fabric type.
services.suitableFor: Shirts, trousers, dresses, blouses, bed sheets.

services.title: Duvets & Bedding
services.body: Deep clean for duvets, pillows and bedding. Fresh sheets without the hassle.
services.includes: Deep cleaning, allergen removal and packaging.
services.suitableFor: Duvets (all sizes/tog), pillows, bed sheets, mattress protectors.

services.title: Curtains & Household Items
services.body: We clean curtains with care and precision, plus tablecloths, towels and other household textiles.
services.includes: Careful measurement, deep cleaning, pressing and folding/hanging.
services.suitableFor: Curtains, blinds, rugs, tablecloths, large towels.

services.title: Wedding Dress Cleaning
services.body: Specialist cleaning to keep your memories perfect. Preserved and boxed with care.
services.includes: Inspection, specialist delicate cleaning, minor repairs and preservation boxing.
services.suitableFor: Wedding dresses, bridesmaid dresses, formal gowns.

services.title: Alterations & Repairs
services.body: Expert alterations for the perfect fit. Hems, resizing and small repairs handled in-house.
services.includes: Pinning/measuring (if applicable), professional tailoring and finishing.
services.suitableFor: Trousers, dresses, suits, zip replacements, button repairs.

services.title: Commercial Laundry
services.body: Hotels, restaurants, Airbnb, spas, salons and more. Reliable high-volume care billed by the kilo.
services.includes: High-temperature wash, automated ironing, flat-folding and regular collection.

services.title: Bag & Shoe Cleaning
services.body: Professional care for your bags and shoes. Restored and refreshed.
services.includes: Deep cleaning, leather conditioning, stain removal and deodorizing.
services.suitableFor: Trainers, leather shoes, suede, handbags, luxury items.

about.title: Professional Laundry & Dry Cleaning Since 2005
about.intro: Since 2005, Super Dry Cleaners has provided professional dry cleaning, laundry and garment care services to customers across Leicester and surrounding areas.
story: Super Dry Cleaners began with a simple idea: professional garment care shouldn't be complicated or expensive. Since 2005, we've grown into Leicester's trusted choice for dry cleaning, laundry and specialist cleaning — serving homes and businesses alike.

Today we handle everything from everyday wash-and-fold to wedding dress preservation and commercial linen. Our team pays attention to detail, uses eco-friendly products wherever possible, and treats every item as if it were our own.

features.title: Free collection & delivery
features.body: Complimentary pickup and return on all orders over £25, across Leicester and surrounding areas.

features.title: Eco-friendly products
features.body: We use environmentally responsible detergents and processes that protect fabric and planet alike.

features.title: Satisfaction guaranteed
features.body: If you're not happy, we'll re-clean it for free. No questions asked.

features.title: Latest machines
features.body: Professional-grade equipment and detergents for premium quality results every time.
